t: Add wheel.framework_version to spoke template WAI-State.json so new spokes get it from init
description: wheel.framework_version separates project version from framework sync version. Already deployed to all spokes; needs to be in template for new spoke init.
perceive: 1. Read templates/spoke/WAI-State.json — check if wheel.framework_version field exists. 2. Read WAI-Spoke/WAI-State.json — confirm framework_version is present (value: '3.0.0'). 3. Read templates/commands/wai-init-v2.md — check if init copies this field.
execute: 1. Add 'framework_version': '3.0.0' to templates/spoke/WAI-State.json under wheel object. 2. Verify wai-init-v2.md copies WAI-State.json from template. 3. If wai-init-v2.md references specific fields to set, add framework_version to the list.
verify: 1. grep framework_version templates/spoke/WAI-State.json — present. 2. New spoke init would get framework_version from template.

_behavior_directive.what_this_is: Add a missing field to the spoke template so new spokes get it automatically
_behavior_directive.what_this_is_NOT: Not retroactively updating existing spokes — the gardener handles that
